{"subject":"Congrats on 100+ new enterprise customers","body":"Hi,

Saw the news in October that Decagon added more than 100 new global enterprise customers in its last fiscal year. That's a real milestone, and great to see support teams at companies like Delta, Snapchat and Ticketmaster running on what you've built.

I'd love to hear how the team is handling that pace of growth and what's next. If you're open to it, could we grab 20 minutes on a call in the coming weeks? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya"}
